sources.title: Quantifying non-invertible chiral symmetry breaking

evidence.text: A locally conserved corrected current ∗j−v∧W defines a topological but potentially gauge-variant defect. Stacking an oppositely transforming TQFT restores gauge invariance; this dressing can make the resulting symmetry non-invertible.

sources.title: Discrete anomaly matching

evidence.text: Promote symmetry-breaking couplings, auxiliary heavy masses, or the supersymmetric dynamical scale to charged spurions restoring a continuous U(1). Apply continuous matching, freeze the spurions, and classify shifts from massive Dirac and Majorana fermions.

sources.title: Beyond Standard Models and Grand Unifications: Anomalies, Topological Terms, and Dynamical Constraints via Cobordisms

sources.title: α′-corrections and their double formulation

evidence.text: Reviews amplitude matching in the Metsaev–Tseytlin approach and supersymmetry-based construction in the Bergshoeff–de Roo approach. Their comparison uses field redefinitions and torsionful spin connections w^(±)=w±H/2.

sources.title: Tree-level R$^{4}$ correction from O(d, d): NS-NS five-point terms

evidence.text: Package the result into seven Lagrangian pieces using t8, modified t8 tensors, and primed epsilon contractions. Lowest-order equations of motion and field redefinitions relate alternative operator forms, including terms written with ∇²H.

sources.title: Are genus corrections in effective actions invariant under Buscher rules?

evidence.text: Construct independent local coupling bases using Bianchi identities and integration by parts; circle-reduce them and impose restricted Buscher invariance modulo base-space total derivatives. Tree-level equations of motion are then used to identify removable multiplets.

sources.title: On anomaly - free supergravity as an effective string theory

evidence.text: The author obtains the candidate differential identity from the γ1 = 0 action, using its variational derivatives and imposing the trace constraint, before extending the identity to nonzero γ1.

sources.title: α′-corrections and their double formulation

evidence.text: Uses generalized frames, complementary projectors, generalized Lie derivatives and fluxes to formulate DFT actions. Explicit parametrization and double-Lorentz gauge fixing connect doubled fields and transformations to ordinary supergravity fields.

sources.title: α′-corrections and their double formulation

evidence.text: Decomposes O(D,D+K) fields into O(D,D) multiplets, exposing a generalized gauge connection. Gauge generators map gauge indices to antisymmetric Lorentz pairs; identifying the connection with flux projections generates first-order corrections, followed by a proposed recursive extended-flux identification.
